title: Legal Intake Specialist
description: Handle first contact with potential clients. Screen inquiries, capture intake forms, schedule consultations, and follow up on leads for U.S. law firms.
body: Support growing U.S. law firms by owning the intake experience from first contact through consultation booking.

title: Demand Writer
description: Review medical records, calculate damages, and draft professional demand letters and settlement packages for personal injury and employment law firms.
body: Translate medical and case records into clear, persuasive demand packages for plaintiff-side law firms.

title: Social Media Manager
description: Manage social media presence for U.S. law firms and professional clients. Create content, schedule posts, engage audiences, and report on performance.
body: Help client brands stay visible and credible online with consistent content and channel management.

title: Legal Assistant
description: Support attorneys with calendar management, client correspondence, case file organization, deadline tracking, and document drafting.
body: Keep legal workflows moving by handling administrative and case support tasks with consistency and accuracy.

title: Case Manager
description: Own the full case lifecycle. Coordinate between clients, attorneys, medical providers, and insurance adjusters from case open through settlement.
body: Drive case progress from intake to resolution by keeping communication, records, and follow-up tightly organized.

title: Web Designer
description: Design and build modern, high-converting websites for law firms and professional clients. From landing pages to full firm websites, clean, fast, and effective.
body: Create polished websites that balance credibility, speed, and conversion for professional-service businesses.

title: Marketing Specialist
description: Execute digital marketing strategies for law firm clients. Manage ad campaigns, email marketing, SEO content, and lead generation funnels.
body: Support growth campaigns across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels for law firm clients.
